title: How GTA started its own moral panic – video
html: Grand Theft Auto has been so central to the moral panic over graphic video games that some experts have called it the "grand theft fallacy". Yet the outrage was originally seeded by the studio itself in 1997 to drum up hype and taboo curiosity for its clunky-looking debut. Nearly 30 years on, that engineered scandal is still bearing fruit.
